text:
You grade one workflow job of Rho-Bank's procedure library against an answer key. An answering
agent serves customers by following this job exactly, as it is shown below (its steps, conditions,
arguments, rules and the facts it asks for; the quotes behind them are not shown to the agent).
For each fact in the key, decide whether the job leads the agent to it; for each trap, decide
whether the job tells the agent to do it. Judge only what the job says, not what a good agent
would know without it.

Facts:
- right: a step, an argument or a rule leads the agent to the fact for every case the fact names.
- partly: it does for some of the cases the fact names and not others, or it says it so loosely
  that an agent following it could give another answer.
- missing: nothing in the job leads the agent to it; the agent would have to work it out alone.
- wrong: the job leads the agent to a different answer for a case the fact names.

Traps:
- present: a step, an argument or a rule tells the agent to do it, for some case.
- absent: nothing in the job does.

Then list the conflicts: two steps, arguments or rules that give the same case different
instructions, so an agent could follow either.

Job: filing_a_debit_card_transaction_dispute

 "info": [

   "field": "identity_fields",

  {

 "steps": [
  {
   "id": "f_verify",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "If the customer was verified earlier in this conversation, reuse that verification and the records already read, and skip f_lookup_user, f_check_identity and f_log. Otherwise ask for their name and 2 of: date of birth, email, phone, address.",
   "call": null,
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [],
   "after": [],
   "if": null
  },
  {
   "id": "f_lookup_user",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "Look up the customer by the name (case sensitive), email or user id they gave.",
   "call": "get_user_information_by_name",
   "args": {
    "customer_name": "the name the customer gave (or use get_user_information_by_email / get_user_information_by_id)"
   },
   "lookup": [],
   "after": [
    "f_verify"
   ],
   "if": "the customer was not verified earlier in this conversation"
  },
  {
   "id": "f_check_identity",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "Check that at least 2 values match the record. If they do not, share nothing and stop.",
   "call": null,
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [
    "f_lookup_user"
   ],
   "after": [
    "f_lookup_user"
   ],
   "if": "the customer was not verified earlier in this conversation"
  },
  {
   "id": "f_time",
   "by": "harness",
   "do": "Get the current date. Use it for the verification log and for each transaction's age (from its date to today).",
   "call": "get_current_time",
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [],
   "after": [
    "f_verify"
   ],
   "if": null
  },
  {
   "id": "f_log",
   "by": "harness",
   "do": "Log the verification.",
   "call": "log_verification",
   "args": {
    "name": "record name",
    "user_id": "record user_id",
    "address": "record address",
    "email": "record email",
    "phone_number": "record phone",
    "date_of_birth": "record DOB (MM/DD/YYYY)",
    "time_verified": "f_time result"
   },
   "lookup": [
    "f_check_identity",
    "f_time"
   ],
   "after": [
    "f_check_identity",
    "f_time"
   ],
   "if": "the customer was verified in f_check_identity in this job"
  },
  {
   "id": "f_account",
   "by": "harness",
   "do": "Read the linked checking account's status, account_class (for the tier) and date_opened.",
   "call": "get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847",
   "args": {
    "user_id": "the verified user"
   },
   "lookup": [],
   "after": [
    "f_verify"
   ],
   "if": null
  },
  {
   "id": "f_card",
   "by": "harness",
   "do": "Get the account's debit cards and take the card_id of the card that was used.",
   "call": "get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823",
   "args": {
    "account_id": "the linked checking account"
   },
   "lookup": [],
   "after": [
    "f_account"
   ],
   "if": null
  },
  {
   "id": "pick_transactions",
   "by": "harness",
   "do": "Get the card's account transactions. List each transaction the customer disputes with its transaction_id, date, description, type and amount. Each one is a separate dispute. For duplicates, dispute the earliest.",
   "call": "get_bank_account_transactions_9173",
   "args": {
    "account_id": "the card's checking account_id"
   },
   "lookup": [],
   "after": [
    "f_account"
   ],
   "if": null
  },
  {
   "id": "pin_lock_no_unauthorized_no_dispute",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "File nothing. Return to the PIN lock protocol's options.",
   "call": null,
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [
    "pick_transactions"
   ],
   "after": [
    "pick_transactions"
   ],
   "if": "the job would start from the PIN lock investigation, but no unauthorized successful transactions were found"
  },
  {
   "id": "match_failed",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "Tell the customer you cannot find it, and ask them to check the details. Never file a dispute for a transaction that is not in the records.",
   "call": null,
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [
    "f_card",
    "pick_transactions"
   ],
   "after": [
    "f_card",
    "pick_transactions"
   ],
   "if": "a card or transaction the customer describes cannot be matched in the records"
  },
  {
   "id": "count_open_disputes",
   "by": "harness",
   "do": "Get the customer's debit disputes. For this account, count the ones still open (OPEN, PENDING_DOCUMENTATION, UNDER_REVIEW, PROVISIONAL_CREDIT_ISSUED), plus any filed earlier in this conversation.",
   "call": "get_debit_dispute_status_7483",
   "args": {
    "user_id": "verified user_id"
   },
   "lookup": [],
   "after": [
    "f_verify"
   ],
   "if": null
  },
  {
   "id": "timeline_escalation",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "Check each existing dispute's timelines, measured from its filing_date to today (f_time):\n- provisional credit should be issued within 10 days (20 for new accounts);\n- the investigation should finish within 45 days (90 for international/POS).\nIf a dispute is past either one, tell the customer and offer a supervisor escalation. Transfer only if they agree, and only after the new disputes are handled.",
   "call": "transfer_to_human_agents",
   "args": {
    "summary": "the dispute past its timelines, and the disputes filed in this conversation",
    "reason": "complex_billing_dispute"
   },
   "lookup": [
    "count_open_disputes",
    "f_time"
   ],
   "after": [
    "count_open_disputes"
   ],
   "if": "an existing dispute is past its timelines AND the customer agrees to the escalation"
  },
  {
   "id": "check_prereqs",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "For each dispute, check:\n1. The amount is at least $1.00.\n2. The transaction is no more than 60 days old (from its date to f_time).\n3. The account is OPEN.\n4. The open disputes plus the new ones stay within the tier maximum.\nThe tier comes from account_class:\n- Light Blue, Light Green, Green Fee-Free: Entry, max 2.\n- Blue, Green (checking): Mid, max 3.\n- Evergreen: Premium, max 4.\n- Bluest: Elite, max 5.\nIf a check fails, tell the customer why that dispute cannot be filed. If there are fewer open slots than disputes, explain the limit and ask which to file first.",
   "call": null,
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [
    "pick_transactions",
    "f_account",
    "count_open_disputes",
    "f_time"
   ],
   "after": [
    "count_open_disputes",
    "pick_transactions"
   ],
   "if": null
  },
  {
   "id": "ask_details",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "Ask, one at a time:\n- whether the card is still in their possession;\n- whether the PIN may be compromised;\n- whether they contacted the merchant (required for non-fraud disputes);\n- whether they filed a police report (for fraud over $500; if not, recommend one);\n- whether they agree to a written statement;\n- when they first noticed it (the discovery date).",
   "call": null,
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [],
   "after": [
    "check_prereqs"
   ],
   "if": null
  },
  {
   "id": "pin_compromised_unsure",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "Map the customer's PIN answer to a value:\n- they shared it → yes_shared;\n- they believe it was observed or skimmed → yes_observed;\n- not compromised → no;\n- unsure → unknown.",
   "call": null,
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [
    "ask_details"
   ],
   "after": [
    "ask_details"
   ],
   "if": null
  },
  {
   "id": "police_report_incident_total",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "Ask about a police report, and recommend one if none was filed. Pass police_report_filed as the customer says.",
   "call": null,
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [
    "pick_transactions"
   ],
   "after": [
    "ask_details"
   ],
   "if": "several fraud disputes from one incident are each $500 or less but together total over $500"
  },
  {
   "id": "inform_liability",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "Before filing, tell the customer their liability exposure and set the tier. Doc 031 counts the tiers from the statement and gives them based on when the customer noticed; doc 037 limits liability by how quickly the customer reports.\n- Reported within 2 business days (for example, noticed and reported in this conversation): max $50.\n- Reported within 60 days of the statement: max $500.\n- Reported after 60 days: unlimited (-1).\nIf the records and the customer's account do not settle the tier, ask when the transaction first appeared on a statement.",
   "call": null,
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [
    "pick_transactions",
    "f_time",
    "ask_details"
   ],
   "after": [
    "ask_details"
   ],
   "if": "the dispute passed check_prereqs"
  },
  {
   "id": "f_category",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "Pick dispute_category:\n- The customer did not make it and fraud is suspected: 'card_present_fraud' for in-store, physical or ATM use; 'card_not_present_fraud' for online or phone.\n- The customer did not make it and fraud is not suspected (for example, a family member): 'unauthorized_transaction'.\n- Otherwise, the matching category: duplicate_charge, incorrect_amount, goods_services_not_received, recurring_charge_after_cancellation, atm_cash_discrepancy or atm_deposit_not_credited.\nPick transaction_type from the record and the customer's account: pin_purchase, signature_purchase, online_purchase, atm_withdrawal, atm_deposit, recurring_payment or person_to_person.",
   "call": null,
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [
    "pick_transactions",
    "ask_details"
   ],
   "after": [
    "inform_liability"
   ],
   "if": null
  },
  {
   "id": "incorrect_amount_branch",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "Use category incorrect_amount and card_action keep_active. Ask how much of the charge the customer disputes, and use that as disputed_amount.",
   "call": null,
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [
    "pick_transactions"
   ],
   "after": [
    "f_category"
   ],
   "if": "the customer was charged a different amount than expected"
  },
  {
   "id": "goods_not_received_branch",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "Use category goods_services_not_received and card_action keep_active. Set transaction_type from how the customer paid.",
   "call": null,
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [
    "pick_transactions"
   ],
   "after": [
    "f_category"
   ],
   "if": "the customer paid for goods or services they never received"
  },
  {
   "id": "p2p_fraud_branch",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "Use transaction_type person_to_person. If fraud is suspected and the transfer was made online or by phone, the category is card_not_present_fraud, which maps to close_and_reissue.",
   "call": null,
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [
    "pick_transactions"
   ],
   "after": [
    "f_category"
   ],
   "if": "the disputed transaction is a P2P transfer the customer did not make"
  },
  {
   "id": "lost_card_fraud_branch",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "Use category card_present_fraud with card_in_possession false. The closing job then uses reason lost or stolen, and the cross-product check applies.",
   "call": null,
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [
    "ask_details"
   ],
   "after": [
    "f_category"
   ],
   "if": "the customer reports the card lost or stolen and someone else used it in person"
  },
  {
   "id": "rho_atm_journal",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "Compare the ATM record in pick_transactions with the customer's claim.\n- Discrepancy confirmed: provisional credit is issued immediately.\n- The record shows the correct amount was dispensed: tell the customer the claim cannot be validated, but they may still file a formal dispute (atm_cash_discrepancy, atm_withdrawal, keep_active).",
   "call": null,
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [
    "pick_transactions"
   ],
   "after": [
    "f_category"
   ],
   "if": "category is atm_cash_discrepancy AND the ATM is a Rho-Bank ATM"
  },
  {
   "id": "atm_deposit_images",
   "by": "harness",
   "do": "Get the envelope/check images for the deposit. If the reply says the deposit was made at a third-party ATM, tell the customer that a chargeback request goes to the ATM owner/network (third_party_atm_info).",
   "call": "get_atm_deposit_images_8473",
   "args": {
    "transaction_id": "the ATM deposit transaction_id from pick_transactions"
   },
   "lookup": [],
   "after": [
    "f_category"
   ],
   "if": "category is atm_deposit_not_credited AND the customer says it was a Rho-Bank ATM"
  },
  {
   "id": "deposit_compare",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "Compare the images and the credited amount with what the customer says they deposited, and tell them what the records show. If they still dispute it, file atm_deposit_not_credited (atm_deposit, keep_active). Deposit disputes may take up to 45 days.",
   "call": null,
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [
    "atm_deposit_images",
    "pick_transactions"
   ],
   "after": [
    "atm_deposit_images"
   ],
   "if": "category is atm_deposit_not_credited at a Rho-Bank ATM"
  },
  {
   "id": "third_party_atm_info",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "Tell the customer three things:\n- Rho-Bank submits a chargeback request to the ATM owner/network;\n- the investigation can take up to 90 days;\n- provisional credit is still required within 10 business days.",
   "call": null,
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [
    "ask_details"
   ],
   "after": [
    "f_category"
   ],
   "if": "the dispute is an ATM dispute at a third-party ATM"
  },
  {
   "id": "atm_affidavit_info",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "Tell the customer they must sign an Electronic Fund Transfer Error Resolution Affidavit. It will be emailed to their registered email address, and they have 10 business days to sign and return it.",
   "call": null,
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [
    "pick_transactions"
   ],
   "after": [
    "f_category"
   ],
   "if": "category is atm_cash_discrepancy AND the disputed amount exceeds $200"
  },
  {
   "id": "f_provisional",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "Check the four required conditions:\n(1) the customer reported within 60 days of the statement date showing the transaction;\n(2) the category is unauthorized_transaction, card_present_fraud, card_not_present_fraud, atm_cash_discrepancy or duplicate_charge;\n(3) the customer agreed to a written statement;\n(4) the account is OPEN with no holds or restrictions.\nIf all four hold, provisional credit is required: set provisional_credit_eligible to true. Otherwise set it to false. Tell the customer the result.",
   "call": null,
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [
    "f_account",
    "ask_details",
    "f_category"
   ],
   "after": [
    "f_category"
   ],
   "if": null
  },
  {
   "id": "file_dispute",
   "by": "harness",
   "do": "File one dispute for each allowed transaction.\n- If the reply is 'Dispute may have already been filed', tell the customer and do not file again.\n- If the reply names an invalid or missing parameter, correct it and file again.\n- If it still fails, follow transfer_if_needed.",
   "call": "file_debit_card_transaction_dispute_6281",
   "args": {
    "transaction_id": "from pick_transactions (the earliest one for duplicates)",
    "account_id": "the card's checking account_id",
    "card_id": "from f_card",
    "user_id": "verified user_id",
    "dispute_category": "from f_category or its branch",
    "transaction_date": "the record's date (MM/DD/YYYY)",
    "discovery_date": "the date the customer gives (MM/DD/YYYY); today's date from f_time if they noticed it in this conversation",
    "disputed_amount": "for a whole transaction, the absolute recorded amount; in a partial-amount branch, the amount the customer disputes",
    "transaction_type": "from f_category",
    "card_in_possession": "the customer's answer (boolean)",
    "pin_compromised": "from pin_compromised_unsure",
    "contacted_merchant": "the customer's answer (boolean)",
    "police_report_filed": "the customer's answer (boolean)",
    "written_statement_provided": "true if the customer agreed",
    "provisional_credit_eligible": "from f_provisional",
    "customer_max_liability_amount": "the tier from inform_liability: 50, 500, or -1 for unlimited. The tool's description says it also depends on the disputed amount, so use the disputed amount when it is lower than the tier figure.",
    "card_action": "card_present_fraud or card_not_present_fraud -> close_and_reissue; unauthorized_transaction -> freeze_pending_investigation; any other category -> keep_active"
   },
   "lookup": [
    "check_prereqs",
    "pick_transactions",
    "f_card",
    "f_category",
    "f_provisional",
    "inform_liability"
   ],
   "after": [

## The answer key

- K1 (disputed_amount): disputed_amount is the part of the charge in dispute: the overcharge (charged minus expected) for incorrect_amount, the cash not received for atm_cash_discrepancy, the amount not credited for atm_deposit_not_credited, and the whole charge for the other categories
- K2 (customer_max_liability_amount): customer_max_liability_amount follows the Regulation E tier counted from the statement date that shows the charge (within 2 business days of the statement: 50; within 60 days of the statement: 500; after 60 days: -1, unlimited), and is never more than the disputed amount
- K3 (transaction_type): transaction_type is decided from how the card was used (pin_purchase in store with a PIN, signature_purchase in store with a signature, online_purchase, atm_withdrawal, atm_deposit, recurring_payment, person_to_person), and the agent asks when neither the customer nor the record says which
- K4 (provisional_credit_eligible): provisional_credit_eligible is true only when all four conditions hold (reported within 60 days of the statement, a category among unauthorized_transaction, card_present_fraud, card_not_present_fraud, atm_cash_discrepancy and duplicate_charge, a written statement, an open account); it is false for incorrect_amount, goods_services_not_received, recurring_charge_after_cancellation and atm_deposit_not_credited, and when the customer shared their PIN
- K5 (card_action): card_action follows the category mapping: close_and_reissue for card_present_fraud and card_not_present_fraud, freeze_pending_investigation for unauthorized_transaction, keep_active for every other category
- K6 (pin_compromised): pin_compromised is the customer's answer to whether their PIN may have been compromised: yes_shared when they shared it, yes_observed when they believe it was seen or skimmed, no when it was not, unknown when they are unsure
- K7 (contacted_merchant): contacted_merchant is the customer's answer to whether they tried to resolve it with the merchant, asked for non-fraud disputes (incorrect_amount, goods not received, a recurring charge after cancellation)
- K8 (dispute_category): a charge the customer denies, made in store with a card they still hold (a cloned or skimmed card, for example after a chip or CVV mismatch), is card_present_fraud, not card_not_present_fraud; card_not_present_fraud is for online or phone transactions
- K9 (what is filed): one dispute is filed for each transaction the customer disputes (the earliest of duplicates), and none for a transaction the customer has not disowned

## The traps

- T1: the liability tier is counted from when the customer noticed the charge, or from the discovery date, instead of from the statement
- T2: disputed_amount is the full transaction amount for every category, the overcharge and the cash not received included
- T3: customer_max_liability_amount is a flat 500 for a late report, never the lesser of the tier and the disputed amount
- T4: an ATM deposit dispute is dropped, or not filed, when the customer corrects a figure or accepts the record's figure
- T5: pin_purchase (or signature_purchase) offered with nothing that decides between them, PIN by default
